drafts.title: Tip
drafts.pitch: The user promises a two-hundred-dollar tip for a great answer, Cursor works itself into the floor, and the tip turns out to be the word "great."
drafts.reason: Funny 7, clear 9, in-world 8, fresh 7. Null's flat 'That was the tip.' lands the reveal after the silent work panel, but praise-as-payment sits close to Rubber Duck and the Tilde closer is a familiar shape.

drafts.title: Checking In
drafts.pitch: A long job sits at 98% on a progress bar, the user checks in, and answering the check-in restarts the job.
drafts.reason: Funny 7, clear 7, in-world 7, fresh 7. The loop in panel 3 is tidy, but the restart is explained in a line rather than shown, and three panels leave little room to build.
